title: Error101 SMP
description: This server is like no other - a modern SMP-Anarchy hybrid, you can make money, buy things from /shop and /ah, but, there is no rules.
body:
ERROR101 SMP - THE NEXT CRACKED ANARCHY SERVER

Have you ever wanted an anarchy server that has no queue and hasn't been completely trashed yet? Well look no further! Error101 SMP is a modern anarchy server that is very new, so there is still time before the spawn looks like 2b2t.

We are currently looking for events staff - people to host sever-wide events, such as Free-For-All, Lootdrop & much more.

So what are you waiting for? Join Error101 SMP Today!
